statement: Threshold repetition for entangled games. Proves exponential threshold repetition for every finite two-player one-round game: if its entangled value is v < 1, the probability of winning at least a fraction $`v+\delta`$ of k independent repetitions decays exponentially in k, for $`0\lt \delta\lt 1-v`$. Arbitrary joint finite-dimensional entangled strategies and correlated question distributions are allowed.
